bali-cultural-peaks-royal-palaces.lead: Bali’s royal and sacred side: palaces, water temples and a clifftop Kecak dance, with a private superyacht transfer to the south.

reasons.d: A private historian tour of Ubud Palace, whose 16th-century pavilions still house the royal family, then the purification pools of Tirta Empul and the royal water palace of Tirta Gangga.

reasons.t: A floating temple and bamboo design
reasons.d: Pura Ulun Danu Beratan’s multi-tiered shrines reflected in a volcanic lake, and an architectural tour of the handcrafted bamboo villa at Hideout Flow.
A private superyacht to the Bukit Peninsula with Uluwatu Temple on its 70-metre cliff in view, a Kecak Fire Dance at sunset, and a candlelit dinner on Jimbaran Bay.

bali-island-jungle-romance.lead: Ubud’s river gorges and waterfalls, a bamboo villa over a volcanic river and a seaplane to Bawah Reserve’s overwater bungalows.

reasons.d: A private guided visit to Tegenungan Waterfall with sunset cocktails on a draped daybed at Omma Ubud, and Cretya Ubud’s infinity pools above the Ayung River gorge and UNESCO rice terraces.
A white-linen hot breakfast at the Sekumpul Hanging Restaurant, then an exclusive-use bamboo villa flowing over a rushing volcanic river, with a lantern dinner on the bank.
A private seaplane into Bawah Reserve, six private islands and three turquoise lagoons, and an overwater bungalow with the reef visible through the floor.

bali-secrets-volcanic-canyons.lead: Bali for people who like to move: white-water rafting, hidden waterfalls and a canyon trek to the island’s tallest cascade.

reasons.d: Private white-water rafting on the Ayung River through class II–III rapids, and a giant swing high over the palm forest at Cretya Ubud.
The Banyumala Twin Waterfalls in a neon-turquoise basin, Tukad Cepung’s sunbeam-lit canyon cavern, and a deep-canyon trek to the base of Sekumpul.
An exclusive-use bamboo villa in the shadow of Mount Agung at Hideout Flow, and a sunrise on the Bukit Cinta ridge.

bali-ultimate-archipelago-secret-falls.lead: Secret waterfalls on Bali, then a private speedboat to Nusa Penida’s T-Rex cliff and Diamond Beach.

reasons.d: Tukad Cepung’s light beams through a narrow canyon, the single elegant column of Leke Leke hidden among ferns, and a Sekumpul Hanging Restaurant breakfast basket.
Kelingking Beach’s T-Rex-shaped limestone cliff, Diamond Beach’s rock pillars, Angel’s Billabong and the sacred blue stairs of Peguyangan Waterfall, with a stay at Maua Nusa Penida.
An exclusive-use bamboo villa built over a flowing river, with Mount Agung rising in the distance.

cambodia-cardamom-jungle-island-frontier.lead: Arrive by zipline at Shinta Mani Wild in the Cardamom Mountains, join anti-poaching rangers, then take a helicopter to Song Saa Private Island.

reasons.d: A 400-metre private zipline glide above the waterfalls straight into camp, then kayaking the Tmor Rung rapids with an elite naturalist and single malts at a rocky ledge beside a crashing waterfall.
An anti-poaching patrol trek with the armed rangers of the Wildlife Alliance, tracking wild elephants and seeing conservation work in the field.

reasons.t: A helicopter to a private island
reasons.d: Song Saa Private Island has an overwater villa on stilts above a protected coral reef, a champagne brunch overlooking the marine reserve, and a bioluminescent night snorkel.

cambodia-khmer-empires-secret-lagoons.lead: Angkor from the former guest villa of King Sihanouk, with dawn at Angkor Wat, Ta Prohm’s roots and a candlelit boat on Angkor Thom’s moat.

reasons.d: Dawn behind the five towers reflected in the lotus pond, then the longest continuous bas-relief carvings in the world with a private historian.
The 216 serene stone faces of Bayon, Ta Prohm’s silk-cotton roots wrapped around collapsed doorways, and remote Beng Mealea.

reasons.t: A royal stay, a moat at sunset
reasons.d: Amansara, once King Norodom Sihanouk’s guest villa, with a private lotus pond, and sunset champagne on a private wooden boat along Angkor Thom’s moat.

cambodia-lost-citadels-northern-canyons.lead: The Cambodia beyond Angkor: a seven-tiered jungle pyramid, a temple on a 525-metre cliff and brick sanctuaries few visitors reach.

reasons.d: Koh Ker’s 36-metre, seven-tiered sandstone step pyramid, rising from dense forest as if lost to time.
The ancient sanctuaries of Preah Vihear on the edge of a 525-metre cliff, with vintage wines on the cliff edge as the sun sets over the plains.
UNESCO-listed Sambor Prei Kuk’s pre-Angkorian brick temples, the remote Preah Khan of Kompong Svay with a hot bento breakfast before anyone else arrives, and a stone-carving masterclass.

cambodia-mekong-capitals-coastal-palaces.lead: Phnom Penh’s palaces from a Mekong suite, then Cambodia’s southern coast: Kep, Kampot pepper and a 7th-century temple inside a cave.

reasons.d: A Mekong Suite at Rosewood overlooking the confluence of the Mekong and Tonle Sap, the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda with its 5,000 silver floor tiles, and a private yacht on the Mekong at sunset.
Phnom Chhnork’s complete 7th-century brick temple standing intact in a limestone cavern.

reasons.t: Coast, pepper and a ghost town
reasons.d: A Kampot pepper plantation and culinary masterclass, the abandoned buildings of Bokor Mountain, and beachfront villas and a mangrove spa at Samanea Wellness Resort.

china-ancient-silk-road-floating-peaks.lead: From the Silk Road’s desert caves to the sandstone pillars of Zhangjiajie and the lights of Chongqing: three very different Chinas.

reasons.d: A private historian-led morning at the UNESCO-listed Mogao Caves, then a camel ride across the singing sands of Mingsha to Crescent Moon Lake.
The glass-fronted Bailong Elevator up a 326-metre cliff, the First Bridge Under Heaven among the sandstone pillars that inspired Avatar, and the Glass Bridge over Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon.
A fast train to Chongqing for the Hongyadong lights, its train through a building, and a sunset at the Southwind Cliff Bistro.

china-deep-heritage-rice-terraces.lead: The Terracotta Army and Xi’an’s city wall by bike, a lantern-lit village, the Li River and the Dragon’s Backbone rice terraces.

reasons.d: A private guided morning with the Terracotta Army, the 14-kilometre Xi’an City Wall cycled in full, and a Tang Dynasty music and dance performance in period costume.
An evening boat ride along Gexian Village’s waterways beneath red silk lanterns, and a Taoist sanctuary hike.
A four-hour luxury Li River cruise to Yangshuo past dramatic karst peaks, the Dragon’s Backbone rice terraces at Longji, and a finish at The Peninsula Shanghai.

china-modern-icons-mystic-valleys.lead: Shanghai’s skyline from The Peninsula, then a lantern village, a cliffside cabin in Wangxian Valley and a private boat on West Lake.

reasons.d: Three nights at The Peninsula with the Pudong skyline across the Huangpu, a private high-speed elevator up the Shanghai Tower for a 360-degree view, and the French Concession and Yu Garden.

A Hanfu dress-up evening in Gexian Fairy Village with water, laser and drone shows, a cable car into misty Taoist peaks with a tea-pouring ceremony, and a night in a cliffside cabin at Wangxian Valley.
A private wooden boat across UNESCO-listed West Lake past islands and pagodas, then Longjing tea plantations and bamboo forests, from the Four Seasons Hangzhou.
